query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.excluded.courses
query.sql:
select distinct cp.coursesdcid, c.course_name, c.course_number, c.credittype, c.sched_department, c.sched_coursesubjectareacode, c.credit_hours, cp.excluded
from u_courses_ptc5 cp inner join courses c on cp.coursesdcid = c.dcid inner join school_course hc on c.id = hc.courseid
where nvl(hc.status,0) = 1 and nvl(cp.excluded,0) = 1 and (:schoolid = '0' or hc.schoolid = :schoolid)
order by c.course_name, c.course_number

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.excluded.sections
query.sql:
select distinct ep.sectionsdcid, c.course_name, e.course_number||'.'||e.section_number as section_number, t.lastfirst, e.room, e.external_expression, ep.excluded, c.dcid as coursedcid, c.course_number, r.name as term
from u_sections_ptc5 ep inner join sections e on ep.sectionsdcid = e.dcid inner join terms r on e.termid = r.id and e.schoolid = r.schoolid inner join courses c on e.course_number = c.course_number inner join teachers t on e.teacher = t.id
where nvl(ep.excluded,0) = 1 and r.yearid = :yearid and (:schoolid = '0' or e.schoolid = :schoolid)
order by 3

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.excluded.students
query.sql:
select distinct sp.studentsdcid, s.lastfirst, s.student_number, s.gender, s.home_room, sp.excluded, s.grade_level
from u_students_ptc5 sp inner join students s on sp.studentsdcid = s.dcid
where nvl(sp.excluded,0) = 1 and (:schoolid = '0' or s.schoolid = :schoolid)
order by s.lastfirst

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.excluded.schoolstaff
query.sql:
select distinct up.schoolstaffdcid, t.lastfirst, t.teachernumber, t.title, t.email_addr, t.homeroom, up.excluded
from u_schoolstaff_ptc5 up inner join teachers t on up.schoolstaffdcid = t.dcid
where nvl(up.excluded,0) = 1 and (:schoolid = '0' or t.schoolid = :schoolid)
order by t.lastfirst
